title: Paths containing spaces cause a panic
body:
### Brief summary

k6 panics when trying to archive or run a script that's located in a path that contains a space.

### k6 version

1.4.0

### OS

macOS Tahoe 26.1

### Docker version and image (if applicable)

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Create a directory with a space in its name
2. `cd` into the directory
3. Create a k6 script
4. Run the script

### Expected behaviour

The script should run normally

### Actual behaviour

A panic is logged to the console:

```
ERRO[0000] unexpected k6 panic: stat /Users/<user>/path%20to%20script/temp.js: no such file or directory
goroutine 1 [running]:
runtime/debug.Stack()

panic({0x105dfd360?, 0x140004084b0?})
        runtime/panic.go:783 +0x120
go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd.analyseUseContraints({0x14000423200?, 0x0?, 0xffffffffffffffff?}, 0x140002ebb00, 0x14000408450)
        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/test_load.go:255 +0x188
go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd.tryResolveModulesExtensions({0x0?, 0x0?}, {0x14000423200, 0x6, 0x6}, {0x1060b0bc0, 0x140000f10a0}, 0x140002ebb00, 0x140003103f0, 0x140001e18c8)
        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/test_load.go:216 +0x78

        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/test_load.go:153 +0xae0
go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd.loadLocalTest(0x140001e18c8, 0x14000287b88, {0x14000111a10?, 0x1057f7550?, 0x106095490?})
        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/test_load.go:110 +0x5cc
go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd.loadAndConfigureLocalTest(0x140001e18c8, 0x14000287b88, {0x14000111a10?, 0x1057f75e0?, 0x14000111ae0?}, 0x106071998)
        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/test_load.go:414 +0x2c
go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd.getCmdRun.func1(0x106095490?, {0x14000111a10?, 0x1060b0ad0?, 0x14000138b80?})
        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/run.go:552 +0x40
go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd.(*cmdRun).run(0x140001115f0, 0x14000287b88, {0x14000111a10, 0x1, 0x1})
        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/run.go:104 +0x1a0
github.com/spf13/cobra.(*Command).execute(0x14000287b88, {0x140001119f0, 0x1, 0x1})
        github.com/spf13/cobra@v1.4.0/command.go:856 +0x548
github.com/spf13/cobra.(*Command).ExecuteC(0x140000eedc8)
        github.com/spf13/cobra@v1.4.0/command.go:974 +0x2e4
github.com/spf13/cobra.(*Command).Execute(...)
        github.com/spf13/cobra@v1.4.0/command.go:902
go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd.(*rootCommand).execute(0x140004373e0)
        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/root.go:127 +0xac
go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd.ExecuteWithGlobalState(0x106095420?)
        go.k6.io/k6/internal/cmd/root.go:35 +0x20
go.k6.io/k6/cmd.Execute()
        go.k6.io/k6/cmd/execute.go:16 +0x30

        go.k6.io/k6/main.go:9 +0x1c 
```

As you can see, the path is URL encoded. It's also notable that it works if you run the script from outside the directory:

```sh
# works
k6 run path\ to\ script/temp.js

# does not work
cd path\ to\ script
k6 run temp.js
```
